title: Senior Product Engineer
description:
Senior Product Engineer - AI-Native, Product Led SaaS Scale-Up - 🚀

Location: Remote Europe
Salary: Up to €120,000 DPE + Bonus + Equity

We're partnering with an exciting, product-led technology business that is building innovative software and looking to expand its engineering team with 3 talented Product Engineers following their recent round of funding.

This is an opportunity to join a technically ambitious environment where engineering, design and product work closely together to build intuitive, high-quality software used by customers globally.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful product features, influence technical decisions and contribute across the engineering lifecycle from initial ideas and architecture through to development, deployment and iteration.

We're particularly interested in engineers who care about the products they build, have strong technical foundations and enjoy working across the stack.

Responsibilities- 🛠️
Taking ownership of end-to-end product development, from conception and design through to deployment.
Building scalable, high-performance applications with a strong focus on usability and user experience.
Working closely with Product Managers, Designers and fellow Engineers to shape the product roadmap.
Developing modern frontend experiences and robust backend services.
Contributing to architectural decisions, technical direction and engineering best practices.
Identifying opportunities to improve performance, scalability and overall product quality.
Experimenting with new technologies and approaches to continuously improve the product.

Requirements- 💻
Experience working as a Product Engineer, Software Engineer, Frontend Engineer or Fullstack Engineer.
Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript and modern frameworks such as React or Next.js.
Experience building and maintaining production-grade applications.
Comfortable working across the stack, with experience developing APIs, backend services and integrations.
A strong understanding of software architecture, performance and maintainable code.
An appreciation for good design, user experience and building intuitive products.
Someone who enjoys taking ownership, working autonomously and collaborating within a fast-moving engineering team.

Ideally- ⭐
Experience within a product-led start-up or scale-up environment.
Exposure to modern cloud infrastructure and deployment practices.
Experience with Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL or similar backend technologies.
An interest in AI-native products, LLM integrations or emerging technologies.
Experience building complex interfaces, interactive applications or collaborative products.

Why Join? 🌍
Opportunity to join an ambitious and growing technology business.
Genuine ownership and influence over the product and engineering direction.
Work alongside talented engineers, designers and product specialists.
A modern engineering environment that encourages experimentation and technical excellence.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunity to make a tangible impact on a product used by customers globally.
